start a call.note: Button Start call = 开始通话; descriptions also use 发起通话 for starting a call in a channel.

end a call.note: End call for everyone = 为所有人结束通话.

make host.note: Existing menu item; 设为主持人 would be more accurate for assigning another participant as host — consider if retranslating.

recording.note: Existing usage is split: 录制 (26) for the feature/action, 录音 (19) for the saved audio. Record call = 录制通话. Prefer 录制 for the feature; 通话录音 is acceptable for the artifact.

transcription.note: Call transcriptions = 通话转录; the text file is 转录文本.

lower hand.note: Existing button label is just 放下; use 放下手 in prose if standalone 放下 is ambiguous.

screen share.note: Majority (8 vs 2 屏幕共享); share their screen = 分享他们的屏幕.

mute.note: Microphone mute; same word as channel mute in the core product.

unmute.note: Majority; 解除静音 appears once.

call ringing.note: Enable call ringing = 启用通话响铃; ringtone in mobile is 来电铃声.

blur background.note: Blur intensity = 虚化强度; use 虚化, not 模糊.
